title: 第18章 道具画被毁
content_zh:
第18章 道具画被毁-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

上一章

存书签

下一章

天天对着纸片人流口水也就罢了，真的到了面前自己居然下口了。

真要命！

让她怎么见人！

发个烧难不成真的连脑袋瓜都烧糊涂了？！

现在满脑子都是沈珩那张妖孽脸和近在咫尺的唇。

很软，很凉。

亲着好舒服……

初吻，血赚！

车门再次打开，韩小汐吓得一个激灵。

又花痴了！

死猪不怕开水烫一般由着斯蒂芬给自己卸妆，任凭他怎么逼问，她除了傻笑，一个字不漏。

斯蒂芬恨恨的将沙发平放成床，像个老妈子一样拉着韩小汐躺下。

“睡你的觉吧！”把沈珩的专属毯子丢给她，斯蒂芬下车前故作神秘的说了句，“你猜，外面会怎么传你们？”

韩小汐白了他一眼，用毯子盖头。

她现在躺在他的保姆车里，本身就说不清了。

不管了！

距离那一天在保姆车上睡了一夜已经好几天了。

韩小汐自己都说不出来为什么会变成现在这样——

这不，她正大光明的被贴上了沈珩的标签。

片场休息时，她堂而皇之的坐在了他的休息椅上，帮于导调整分镜。

斯蒂芬和郭炜拿她当自己人，吃的喝的都会给她带一份。

连原本拿她当片场小妹的道具组长也会很客气的喊她一声“小韩老师”。

所有人都觉得她应该和沈珩有些关系。

而当事人本人对她却一直客气有礼，没有半分暧昧，永远保持着恰到好处的距离。

但若有似无得关心和照顾比以往更甚。

听斯蒂芬说，剧组里传他们什么的都有，但都成不了气候。

毕竟沈珩对她的态度怎么看都不像是男人对女人的样子。

一点暧昧都没有。

“老板可能真的把你当小孩。”这是郭炜观察了好几天之后的答案，“而且还是一个需要他照顾的小孩。”

韩小汐瘪嘴，她能感觉出来的好不好。

不需要他刻意提醒。

说白了就是没有CP感呗。

自己还真是够失败的，都亲亲抱抱举高高了，都没人觉得她和影帝有什么。

不知道是影帝的人设太成功，还是自己太拉胯。

就连沈轩都跑过来问她，沈珩是不是受人之托照顾她。

Chapter 18 The prop painting was destroyed - "Time Travel 2006 Little Hand Substitute Being Chased and Pampered by the Movie King"

It’s just a matter of drooling in front of the paper man every day, but actually he actually started drooling when he was in front of him.

Really terrible!

How can she meet people?

Is it possible that if you have a fever, your head will be burnt?!

Now his mind was filled with Shen Heng's evil face and lips so close at hand.

So soft and cool.

It feels so comfortable to kiss...

First kiss, blood money!

The car door opened again, and Han Xiaoxi shivered with fright.

Crazy again!

The dead pig let Stephen remove her makeup as if she were not afraid of boiling water. No matter how much he pressed her, she would not miss a word except a silly smile.

Stephen bitterly flattened the sofa into a bed and pulled Han Xiaoxi to lie down like an old mother.

"Go to sleep!" Throwing Shen Heng's exclusive blanket to her, Stephen pretended to be mysterious and said before getting out of the car, "Guess what will happen to you outside?"

Han Xiaoxi rolled her eyes at him and covered her head with a blanket.

She was lying in his nanny's car now, which was hard to explain.

No matter!

It had been several days since that day when I slept in the nanny's car.

Han Xiaoxi herself couldn’t explain why it became like this——

No, she was labeled Shen Heng openly.

During the break on the set, she sat on his lounge chair majestically and helped the director adjust the storyboard.

Stephen and Guo Wei regarded her as one of their own and would bring her a share of food and drink.

Even the props team leader who originally regarded her as the little girl on the set would politely call her "Teacher Xiao Han".

Everyone felt that she should have some relationship with Shen Heng.

But the client himself was always polite and courteous to her, without any ambiguity, and always maintained a just right distance.

But if there seems to be no concern and care than before.

I heard from Stephen that there were rumors among the crew that they had everything, but none of them became a reality.

After all, Shen Heng's attitude towards her didn't look like a man towards a woman.

There is no ambiguity at all.

"The boss may really treat you as a child." This was Guo Wei's answer after observing for several days, "and you are still a child who needs his care."

Han Xiaoxi pursed her lips, she could feel it.

There was no need for him to remind me deliberately.

To put it bluntly, there is no sense of CP.

She was really a failure. She was kissed, hugged and lifted up, but no one thought she had anything to do with the actor.

I don’t know if it’s the actor’s character that’s too successful, or if he’s too stretched.

Even Shen Xuan came over and asked her if Shen Heng was entrusted by someone to take care of her.
